 2 sAhAyyaM.
ⓃFriendly,Ⓒa.ⒹsnigDa, sadaya, hita-kAma, hitEzin, snehaSIla, sAnurAga, suhfdaya, sapraRaya.

Ⓝ[Fright]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹBIma, vikawa, karAla, dAruRa, BIzaRa, Gora, BErava (vI f.), rOdra (drI f.), BayAnaka, BayAvaha, ugra, BayaMkara; ‘f(rightful) in appearance’ karAlavadana, BIma-rOdra-darSana, ugradarSana.
Ⓝ[Fright]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹdAruRaM, GoraM, ugraM.

Frigid,Ⓒa.ⒹSIta, SiSira, hima, jaqa.

Fringe,Ⓒs.ⒹaMcalaH-laM, daSAH (f. pl.), bastayaH (m. f.); ‘like a f(ringe) rent from the robe of heaven’ CinnA ivAMbarapawasya daSAH (Mr. 5).
